name: recipes-audit
description: The judgement half of this repo's gates (#176): the recurring defects that are type-correct, lint-clean, fully tested, green, and still describe something that is not true. Two skills because they have two different oracles — `audit-change` reviews a diff against the intent it claims and against the tree that moved under it, `audit-corpus` reviews the tree against production. Whatever could be a gate already is one, in CI; these are what is left. No version field, so it tracks the repo it ships in — an audit that lags the code it audits is worse than none.
